_comment: A Prince of Persia 2 project needs no file of its own: the game is the original files, which the project brings as firmware (the core's firmware list). A saved game is the one file a project may add.

slots.title: Saved game
slots.help: A PRINCE.SAV the game saved (Alt+G), for a run that starts from a saved game: the game finds it as its own, and Alt+L on the title or in a level restores it. Leave it empty to start from the title.
